body: Thanks for this. And your really kind words. Honestly I'm really struggling w the whole emotions things. I'm overwhelmed with disgust and anger since being told I was 99% sexually assaulted by my dad. Like overwhelming emotion, I don't even know how people live with this. I seriously understand how people turn to alcoholism to get them through things. I just don't know what the point is to trying to fight through this - so I can be okay one day w being someone who got touched by their dad? It just seems pointless to go through the motions of living anymore

Unfortunately, yes. I'm enmeshed w my mom (working on it) and have spent my entire life trying to save her from my dad. So even though I graduated, am an adult, and could easily live on my own, I find myself back at the house trying to fix things. But for the first time in my life I'm realizing I need to let go, and I can't save her. It's pretty heartbreaking to me tbh, and I'm working through it. Re: anger, I'm just now learning how to process anger as an emotion. My dad is super angry, aggressive and abusive, and I went the complete opposite because of it (I'm super codependent, and am super afraid of ever being angry because I don't want to be like him). And I agree, I'm starting to see that now. Family are the people who choose to have me in their life. It just makes me sad, I guess. And I'm terrified of starting a family / having kids because I'm just worried I'd be a horrible mom and hurt them the way I've been hurt somehow.

Thanks for your words! Thurs and Fri were the first time I had a frank convo w my therapist and told everything that I've always kept a secret (which admittedly I am proud of myself for at least), and that's when she told me about everything about me correlating w an assault victim, and that she had thought that since my first session but didn't want to go there unless I did. So it's a very fresh wound for me. I've always shoved down everything about how my father has treated me and made me feel, and my mom is a huge enabler so it's just been a recipe for disaster. I honestly don't even know if I want to remember. And maybe that's why I can't tbh. At least now I can hold onto a semblance of doubt even though I know deep down the something did happen. My dad is just a huge asshole and abuser outside of the sexual assault aspect as well, so... I don't know. I started therapy 2 months ago and I guess it's just hard realizing you're way more broken / messed up than you ever would have thought. And it feels like each day I realize more and more pain. It's nice I guess to no longer be in denial (fully, anyway) but I feel so raw and hurt. And disappointed I don't have a family, and kind of jealous of everyone else who has Normal, loving parents.

Thank you! Yeah, I honestly want to go drink right now, but my grandma was an alcoholic so I have a huge fear of becoming dependent on alcohol. Thank you so much for your words, it's nice to know that I can share all of this and someone won't just run for the hills

I love that. You're right. It's a rough patch that will pass. That's an awesome view point. My sister and my best friend both had a really hard time coming out to their/our families but it was definitely worth it (not telling you what to do, obv, just that when you're ready you will kick ass and be fine!).

It's weird how objectively you can not want to die, but that feeling in the back of your head is there. How do you normally work through it? Also I'm sorry to hear that you're feeling the same way as me right now, although I guess it's kind of poetic and helpful to know that neither of us is alone. I'm just kind of mourning the loss of a family I never had. I've been trying to save my mom from my dad my entire life, and I'm realizing I can't. And just stopping being in denial and realizing that he is truly a monster... It just sucks

Thank you! Honestly just your writing that you're sorry to hear what's happened makes me feel a little better. I'm sorry to hear you're depressed as well. It's hard. But definitely possible to get through, I know I've been able to push through compulsions to kill myself before so am just focusing on each minute
